trigger.statement: This amendment was triggered after observing that four n=4 Formal Experiment A conditions reached the original 600-second per-run wall-time guard during optimizer execution.

before.scientific_consequence: wall-clock censoring made effective optimization budget depend on n and p

after.purpose: protect against OS hang, deadlock, pathological or infinite execution only
after.intended_behavior: not reached during ordinary formal execution and not used to censor the algorithmic comparison

research_budget.final_expectation_evaluation: additional to objective callback cap, unchanged

stop_condition_semantics.wall_time_mapping_rule: A wall-time safety stop is never described as an optimizer failure unless the optimizer independently reports a genuine failure. Historical labels and bytes are not rewritten.

unchanged_research_factors.authority: unchanged exact references and R20/R21/R22 authority

runtime_as_outcome.role: measured outcome/diagnostic, never an optimization stopping budget

historical_evidence_treatment.interpretation: The four records do not establish mathematical QAOA failure, intrinsic COBYLA failure, n=4 infeasibility, or p=3 non-completion. They establish only that the original 600-second policy prevented full observation.

claim_prohibition: Do not claim the original experiment had no wall-time limit.
Do not claim this amendment was preregistered.
Do not claim the four original records were fully optimized.
post_hoc_disclosure.versioning_decision: Keep R23_FORMAL_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN_V1 recoverable and link this separate amendment; do not silently overwrite V1 or relabel it as preregistered amended design.

corrective_completion_policy.only_difference: removal of the binding 600-second research wall-time cap; retain only the non-binding emergency safety policy
corrective_completion_policy.methodological_rationale: The 41 unaffected observations already use the frozen scientific factors. Completing only the four right-censored cells restores the missing algorithmic observations while preserving the original 45-run evidence and avoids changing the estimand or introducing unnecessary new runs. Full reexecution is not required because no scientific factor, implementation authority, or comparison target changed.
corrective_completion_policy.required_controls: same instance, p, lambda, initialization, COBYLA, maxiter, objective cap, seeds, runtime environment, exact references, and metrics
